plugins.name: video-analysis
plugins.description: Watch, analyze, and take structured knowledge notes from videos. Handles YouTube, TikTok, Douyin, RedNote/Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, any yt-dlp-supported site, or a local file, by decomposing the video into frames plus a transcript and writing timestamped notes.
